text.card: A red giant 3,459 parsecs away, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 12, give 0.94 solar masses and 12.0 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,989 K at its surface.
